instructions.allowed_edits: Implementation agents may update only status, evidence, and notes unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only when the actor report links deterministic validation and an independent critic artifact approves or explicitly records a user waiver.

features.description: On the chosen implementation branch, a verified capability inventory proves which Assistant capabilities are native, model-native, MCP, Skill, Connector, or Knowledge, and tests prove an Agent allowlist can only reduce the runtime tool set.
steps: Compare the target branch with origin/main and record the exact code baseline.
Trace every production composition-root registration and reachable management route.
Run isolation and tool-selection contract tests, including denial of a tool omitted from the Agent allowlist.
Publish a capability matrix, unresolved wiring defects, and stable interfaces for AS-01 and AS-02.
features.notes: Post-authorization Actor evidence includes 13 focused tests, 88 adjacent regressions, Ruff, diff hygiene, and make test-isolation with 6 passed and no skips over a memory-bounded local Gateway-to-Assistant runtime. The first authorized run failed 2 login cases on a fresh database and was corrected by creating the local dev admin; it is not counted as a pass. A fresh independent Critic reran every required group, obtained the same passing/no-skip results, and approved AS-F001. The strict AS-00 completion gate then exited zero with quality score 100. No real API Key was read or changed, and the localhost model stub proves transport/contract behavior only. AS-01 is unlocked; AS-F002 through AS-F010 remain failing.

features.description: An authorized tenant user can create, read, edit with optimistic concurrency, version, share by role, copy, archive, and list Agents without reading or mutating another tenant's Agent or silently overwriting a newer Draft.
steps: Create an Agent and persist a mutable Draft with revision 1.
Attempt a stale If-Match update and observe AGENT_DRAFT_CONFLICT without lost changes.
Create an immutable Version and verify later Draft edits do not mutate it.
Exercise Owner, Editor, Viewer, last-owner, cross-tenant, copy, archive, and soft-delete cases.
features.notes: AS-01 Actor and fresh independent Critic both ran all required checks with no skips: live PostgreSQL migration contract 9 passed, Agent API/RBAC 13 passed, Gateway regression 14 passed, and Ruff passed. Full live Gateway OpenAPI contains nine Agent paths without token_hash or secret_ref; generated-password Agent lifecycle, Viewer and cross-tenant HTTP probes also passed on the repository-owned stack. The independent fresh-context reviewer approved AS-01/AS-F002 after reviewing the frozen migration, repository, API, tests, runtime ownership and memory evidence. The strict AS-01 completion gate exited zero with quality score 100. AS-02 is unlocked; AS-F003 through AS-F010 are still failing.

features.description: Each Preview or published conversation is resolved by Gateway into a signed identity/session/body-bound Agent Runtime Envelope, verified by Assistant, pinned to its Agent Version, and limited to capabilities allowed by tenant, version, channel, caller, credential principal and readiness policies.
steps: Start sessions for two Agents with different prompts and capability bindings.
Verify prompt, memory, tools, idempotency, checkpoints, runs, and traces cannot cross Agent or tenant boundaries.
Promote a Publication and verify existing sessions stay pinned while new sessions use the new Version.

Attempt generic-Assistant model/prompt/capability/snapshot/header forgery, signed Snapshot mutation, expired/replayed Envelope and body/session substitution; prove hash recalculation and atomic nonce consumption fail closed with a policy trace.
features.notes: Fresh Critic changes_requested verdicts are preserved as iterations 1 and 2. Actor iteration 3 closed residual C-01 wrong-session finalization and C-05 same-ID capability metadata substitution. The iteration-3 independent Critic reproduced both fixes, confirmed C-02/C-03/C-04, found no new material issue, and approved AS-02 after all five required gates exited zero with no skips: 27/23/45, AHR 28/77/8/98 plus golden, live isolation 6/6 and Ruff clean. Supplemental migration 5, golden 14/14, Docgen 135, scripts 94 and resume/API 45 also passed. Final runtime was 8/8 healthy around 720 MiB, stub=false, provider inputs absent, and Preview failed closed as 503 AGENT_RUNTIME_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.

features.description: A Tenant Admin can register remote Streamable HTTP MCP and existing Connector connections, explicitly choose service-account or user-delegated principals, discover versioned schemas, and bind authorized tools without SSRF, plaintext secrets, cross-user/anonymous credential fallback, or production schema drift.
steps: Register mock no-auth, bearer, service-account and user-delegated OAuth connections plus an existing Connector; inspect redacted API responses.
Reject private/disallowed destinations, redirect/DNS rebinding, bad Origin, wrong audience, oversized response, and cross-tenant access.
Discover tools, publish a schema hash, change the server schema, and observe a blocking diff for the next Version.
Verify User A/User B/anonymous/public channel separation, timeout, concurrency, circuit breaker, audit, disable, grant expiry and revocation behavior.
features.notes: Three preserved changes_requested reviews drove connection-effective DNS pinning, untrusted remote classification removal, exact-schema public Admin grants, conservative recursive schema compatibility and save-time private-destination rejection. On the frozen final source, the Actor and amended iteration-3 independent Critic both ran every required gate with zero skips: API 6, Assistant runtime/policy/Connector 23, security 19, migration 3, Ruff clean, live isolation 6/6 and AHR 28/77/8/98 plus golden. Final Compose was 8/8 healthy around 730.5 MiB, ownership correct, stub=false and host/container source hashes equal. Third-party OAuth remains an explicit no-credential external smoke deferral, not production proof; no required security gate is waived.

features.description: An Agent Version executes an exact authorized instruction-only Skill version and normalized Knowledge Dataset bindings, rejects tenant executable entrypoints, records Skill hashes and live-content provenance without claiming replayability, and fails closed on revocation or unavailability.
steps: Upload a valid instruction-only SKILL.md and reject forged source/builtin/path/network/exec entrypoints; bind its normalized exact version, update it, and prove the old Agent Version does not drift.
Exercise list/read/update/enable/disable across two tenants and prove registry/cache isolation.

Persist normalized tenant-scoped Draft/Version Dataset bindings, run retrieval with provenance, record the live revision fingerprint, and expose that historical content replay is unavailable unless the Knowledge service supports it.
Revoke Skill/Dataset access and verify Preview, publish, and runtime denial/degradation behavior.
features.notes: Three preserved changes_requested reviews drove authoritative content revision, credential/telemetry-safe retrieval fingerprints, exact per-Dataset auto/tool/off execution, and production DB-backed resource policy wiring. On frozen iteration-4 source, Actor and fresh Critic required gates passed with zero skips: Skill API/isolation 26, exact Skill runtime 6, Knowledge/streaming 45 and Ruff clean; supplemental migration 4, fingerprint 5 and production resolver 8 also passed. A running-container real-PostgreSQL probe proved non-expanding policy and current Dataset revocation, with temporary rows removed. AHR 33/77/8/98 plus golden and explicit local stub isolation 6/6 preserve Assistant compatibility. provider_calls=0 and historical_replayable=false are explicit evidence boundaries, not external-provider readiness claims.

features.description: An Owner can create and configure an Agent in a responsive, keyboard-accessible Studio, understand capability source/risk/setup state, recover from save conflicts, and run a Draft or Version Preview that clearly shows its effective configuration.
steps: Create an Agent from blank and template paths, then configure identity, instructions, model, capabilities, knowledge, memory, and welcome content.
Observe clean, dirty, saving, saved, validation, conflict, permission, degraded, and network-recovery states.
Run Preview for a saved Draft and historical Version without hot-swapping an existing session.
Verify desktop, tablet, mobile, keyboard, screen-reader labels, axe, reduced-motion, console, and network evidence.
features.notes: Two preserved changes_requested reviews drove atomic metadata/spec/revision persistence, closed Agent SSE projection, default-Compose rollback wiring, mobile role actions, real keyboard/focus and executed Editor save/Preview evidence, plus truthful exact viewport receipts. On frozen iteration-3 source, Actor and fresh Critic independently passed all required gates with zero skips: frontend static, Agent E2E 25, full OSS E2E 31, Agent API 9 and Assistant resolver 11. Supplemental runtime-config/Compose 5 plus real PostgreSQL trigger rollback 1, Ruff and diff hygiene also passed. The supported phase claim check exited 0 with structure score 100/100 after its first truthful metadata-drift rejection; the tool explicitly checks metadata only. The built-container false/true rollback and live local provider-unavailable flow preserve Assistant compatibility without claiming external-provider success, deployment, AS-06 publication, or AS-09 whole-demand completion.

features.description: An Owner can validate and evaluate a Draft, inspect a deterministic diff, publish an immutable Version to a channel, and atomically roll back while failed or stale gates cannot be bypassed by the client.
steps: Run configured golden, trajectory, tool, RAG provenance, safety, latency, and cost gates for a Draft revision.
Change the Draft after evaluation and prove the stale evaluation cannot publish the newer revision.
Publish idempotently, verify the immutable Version and append-only promotion audit, then edit Draft without production drift.
Rollback to a healthy historical Version and verify new versus existing session behavior.
features.notes: Iteration-1 through iteration-3 changes_requested verdicts are preserved. Iteration 3 closed C-06 but reproduced C-07; Actor iteration 4 locks the Dataset parent FOR UPDATE and every manifest example FOR SHARE. Focused real PostgreSQL update and insert cases both remain blocked until Publish commits. Final-source zero-skip gates pass: publish/API/PostgreSQL/gate 35; candidate 13 plus golden 16/16 and Eval 41/116/35/17; frontend static/release 10; AHR 33/77/8/98 plus golden and isolation 6/6. The fresh iteration-4 Critic independently matched 13/13 hashes, reran Ruff, focused 2 and required 35 with zero skips, found no new material blocker and approved C-07 closure. The supported non-legacy claim check then exited 0 with structure score 100/100; it explicitly checks metadata consistency only. AS-F007 is passing and AS-07 is dependency-unlocked.

features.description: A published Agent can be used through a stable Hosted URL/new window, an origin-restricted iframe/Widget, and a scoped streaming Runtime API without exposing server tokens, internal configuration, disallowed tools, or cross-channel sessions.
steps: Exercise private, tenant, and public Hosted modes with welcome, chat, attachments, citations, errors, quotas, and disabled state.

Install the Widget on allowed and rejected Origin fixtures; verify the built Hosted page remains anti-framed, the dedicated Embed response has Publication-specific frame-ancestors with no SAMEORIGIN XFO, and postMessage/focus/token/network contracts pass.
Create, rotate, scope, expire, and revoke a hashed Runtime API token; verify SSE, idempotency, attachment, feedback, and rate-limit contracts.
Prove anonymous Hosted/Embed sessions are session-memory-only and cannot call high-risk capabilities by default.
features.notes: The preserved iteration-1 changes_requested verdict identified process-local bypassable quotas, duplicate idempotent execution, and missing Hosted attachment/citation behavior. Actor iteration 2 closed them with one Redis-Lua decision over principal/IP/Publication minute/day buckets and a stable HMAC Embed abuse identity; durable pending/completed/failed idempotency with exact SSE replay and one downstream invocation; and policy-gated opaque attachment handles resolved server-side through shared Gateway/Assistant storage plus typed citation rendering. Final Actor gates are zero-skip: runtime/security 24, real PostgreSQL 3, Hosted/Embed browser 8, deployment headers 5 plus config-only, frontend lint/type/i18n/build, built-image headers, AHR 33/77/8/98 plus golden, current isolation coverage and OSS browser 41. Live Redis atomic and shared-storage probes passed with formal Gateway/Assistant/Frontend healthy and Stub disabled. The fresh iteration-2 Critic independently matched 24/24 fingerprints and reran 40 tests with zero failures/skips plus the config-only header gate, closed C-01 through C-03, and approved. The supported legacy-compatible phase claim check exited 0 with structure score 100/100 and explicitly validates metadata only; current strict certification is unavailable for the v2 Harness. AS-F008 is passing and AS-08 is dependency-unlocked; AS-09 same-build whole-demand completion remains pending.

features.description: Owners and Admins can operate Agents with per-version/channel traces, metrics, audits, quotas, retention and deletion, while additive migration/feature flags preserve the built-in Assistant and a versioned aggregate manifest includes every earlier required gate.
steps: Filter metrics/traces by Agent, Version, Publication, channel and time; verify redaction and retention.
Exercise audit, quota, archival, token revocation, user deletion, tenant deletion, legal-hold, and cache invalidation paths.
Run migration idempotency/application rollback and enable/disable flags without losing existing Assistant sessions.
Contract-test that make verify-agent-studio includes every AS-00 through AS-08 required command, including Envelope, credential, Skill entrypoint, publish atomicity and built-header gates.
features.notes: Two preserved changes_requested reviews drove the complete TTFT/tool/Knowledge/feedback metric set, recursive at-rest audit redaction plus binding/high-risk events, authoritative Agent/Publication/concurrency/token/MCP/storage quotas, legal-hold-safe retryable deletion, zero-skip aggregate acceptance and completed tenant-receipt replay after ACL teardown. Final Actor required gates are zero-skip: operations/governance/migration 24, aggregate contract 5, analytics browser 5 plus lint/type/i18n/build, AHR 33/77/10/98 plus golden, and credentialed isolation 6/6. Migration 081 is additive/reentrant and was re-applied to the owned local PostgreSQL stack; authenticated live probes covered metrics/quotas/audit and exact deletion replay with another user denied. Fresh iteration-3 Critic matched 30/30 fingerprints, independently passed focused PostgreSQL 1 and exact required 24 with zero skips, closed C-04-R2 and approved. AS-F009 is passing; AS-09 same-build whole-demand regression remains unclaimed.

features.description: A no-feature terminal evaluation reruns the critic-approved aggregate in one compatible build, records build/manifest hashes and complete browser/migration/security/rollback evidence, and separates implementation completion from deployment authorization.
steps: Confirm AS-00 through AS-08 each have passed actor and independent critic artifacts and the aggregate manifest hash matches AS-08.
Run make verify-agent-studio without editing product source, tests, or gates; route any failure back to its owner Phase.
Record whole-demand, built-header, accessibility, migration, feature-flag and built-in Assistant evidence from the same build hash.
Write the terminal actor report, obtain an independent release critic, then let the orchestrator update Oracle evidence and run the full completion gate.
features.notes: The accepted post-repair candidate executed the immutable AS-08 manifest from one stable source hash and passed 39/39 required gates with zero skips and zero failures; all 39 log hashes, the result hash, manifest hash and current source fingerprint were independently matched. Same-run evidence covers Agent CRUD/custom Prompt/Preview, MCP/Connectors, Skills/Knowledge, Eval/version publish/rollback, Hosted/Embed/Runtime API, real built-image headers, desktop/tablet/mobile accessibility, additive migrations 071-081, governance/privacy/security and built-in Assistant AHR 33/77/10/98 plus golden and isolation 6/6. The fresh terminal Critic approved with no blockers and supports ready-but-not-deployed. The installed lightweight validator cannot issue legacy strict certification for this v2 Harness; its supported structure validation passed 100/100 and is metadata-only. External provider quality, production Secret/OAuth/egress and deployment/monitoring authorization remain explicitly deferred deployment-readiness items, not local implementation claims.
